conclusion: Sigmoid Q/V slightly improved final loss in this seed. Parameter-free soft RMS normalization worsened it. Non-amplification is a mathematical property, not evidence of better language modeling.
limitations: Single seed; no convergence or statistical significance established.
Soft norm removes 4,608 learned gains as well as changing the denominator.
Stage 1 ran before a battery interruption; stage 2 afterward. Timings are observed durations, not a controlled isolated speed ablation.
current_configuration: sigmoid Q/V with soft_rms; rms remains selectable through configs/model/model.py
